architecture: Layering (unchanged at HEAD): learn-quality.ts owns pure types/validators/gate logic (ReviewRole, ReviewFinding, ReviewReceipt, reviewGateIssues, parseReviewerVerdict, computeFindingKey) and imports nothing from the review modules. review-runtime.ts is the only layer that talks to a model; it takes an injected ReviewerRunOptions {model, modelRegistry, thinkingLevel, cwd, prompt, tools, prepareEvidence, signal, onProgress, limits} and returns a bare ReviewerVerdict (never a receipt). review-layer.ts adds the receipt writer: it builds scoped ReviewPackets, binds bound read-only evidence readers (createReviewEvidence over ingest.extractSourcePages/renderPdfPage/obsidian-paths.snapshotAssetPath/storage.safePathWithinRoot), enforces per-role evidence coverage, hashes verdicts into ReviewReceipts, caches per-packet batch passes, and aggregates. learn-review.ts is the Learn-shaped facade (planReviewAssignments crew planner, reviewLearnDraft, reviewLearnQuestion) plus a pass-through re-export of the whole review-layer surface. Dependence direction: learn-review -> review-layer -> review-runtime -> learn-quality. Coordination state (hash-bound approvals, finding responses) lives in lesson.ts/types.ts/state-schema.ts and is still enforced; only the receipt producer is unwired.

## review-layer.ts (616 lines)

Purpose: the receipt-writing review API over a bounded model call. It builds role-scoped `ReviewPacket`s, binds read-only evidence readers to one section/book, runs `runReviewer` per packet, enforces that the reviewer actually read/viewed/inspected each required item, and returns hash-bound `ReviewReceipt`s. It also carries the Exam/Tutor packet planners.

# 2. Model invocation

No direct HTTP, no `pi` tool API, no fetch. The model is an injected port resolved from `ExtensionContext`:

- Default (no reasoning level), review-runtime.ts:297:
  `response = await abortable(Promise.race([options.modelRegistry.complete(options.model, context, requestOptions), stallPromise]), signal);`
- With a reasoning level, review-runtime.ts:307-316:
  `const provider = options.modelRegistry.getProvider!(options.model.provider);` then `provider.streamSimple(requestModel, context, {...requestOptions, apiKey, headers, env, reasoning})`, preceded by `getApiKeyAndHeaders` (:309).
- `requestOptions` = `{signal, maxTokens, timeoutMs, maxRetries: 0, sessionId: requestSessionId, transport: "sse"}` (~:292).

Binding from the review layer, review-layer.ts:318-322: `runReviewer({role, model, modelRegistry: ctx.modelRegistry, thinkingLevel: ctx.thinkingLevel, cwd: config.obsidianRoot, signal, onProgress, limits, tools, prompt, prepareEvidence?})`. `ctx: ExtensionContext` from `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`; the reviewer never receives `ctx` itself — only those three fields plus the vault dir (AGENTS.md:39-44).

Type contracts the caller must satisfy:
- `ReviewerProgress` (review-runtime.ts:21) — the `onProgress` shape; mirrored in `ReviewRunnerOptions.onProgress` (review-layer.ts:143) and consumed by `ScholarLoadingProgress.loadingReview(event: ReviewerProgress | undefined, total)` (runtime-coordinator.ts:389).
- `onCheckpoint?: (role: ReviewRole, batches: ReviewBatchPass[]) => void` (review-layer.ts:150) — called at :444 in `settle` after each successful packet.
- `prepareEvidence?: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<(TextContent|ImageContent)[]>` (review-runtime.ts ~:75) — implemented at review-layer.ts:339-355 when `options.prepared` (the Learn path), which then sets `tools: []` and `maxTurns: 2`.
- `ReviewerTool.execute(callId, args: Record<string, unknown>, signal: AbortSignal)`, args validated with `Value.Check(tool.parameters, args)` (review-runtime.ts ~:407).
